subject: Urgent: ACME Fin incident — request for runtime artifacts & handling
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@acme-fin.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.example
Cc: support@acme-fin.com
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: P1: Spike in 95th latency + errors — need artifacts for audit

Hi Irene,

Over the last hour we've been seeing a large spike in 95th percentile latency (from ~220ms to ~1.6s) and error rates jumped to ~6% for a subset of user sessions. Throughput for the /generate endpoint also dropped ~30% at peak. Our compliance team is starting an internal audit and needs the runtime artifacts from the incident window (08:05–08:58 UTC). Specifically we need: 

- Per-request headers and anonymized session IDs for affected requests (tokenized IDs are fine).
- Prefix/KV cache metrics and any cache evictions during the window.
- Server-side error logs with stack traces, and the set of model variants used for each request.
- Any live sampling of prompt/response pairs (minimally redacted to remove PII).

Also can you confirm how Redwood will handle retention of these artifacts: where they will be stored, how long they will persist, and the chain-of-custody for any artifacts you hand over to us? Legal may request a signed manifest/hash to accompany exported files.

We appreciate quick turnaround — our audit kickoff is in ~6 hours.

Thanks,
Lydia
Security & Compliance, ACME Financial

Attachment: incident-summmary-ACME-1115.pdf (stub)

From: irene.choi@redwood.example
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@acme-fin.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.example, jonas.weber@redwood.example
Date: 2026-11-15T09:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: P1: Spike in 95th latency + errors — need artifacts for audit

Hi Lydia — thanks for the details and the window. We're treating this as P1 and will assemble an artifact package for you. Quick notes / immediate next steps from our side: 

1) Monica and Jonas are standing up a forensics snapshot of the runtime cluster (KV cache state, per-host logs, model routing traces).
2) We will produce a minimally redacted bundle containing: per-request metadata (timestamp, route, model id, token counts), server error logs, and cache/eviction summaries. We will not include raw customer prompts with direct PII; we'll provide tokenized identifiers and redacted snippets where needed.
3) We'll create a signed manifest (SHA256) for any exported archive and publish it to a secure drive link.
4) Please confirm whether ACME requires full prompt text for a subset of requests (if so, we need an explicit legal hold/consent).

Can you also confirm the preferred delivery channel: secure Drive link or SFTP/secure transfer? I will loop in David for the actual log export and hash.

Irene
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference

On 2026-11-15 09:12 -08:00 Lydia Park wrote:
> Hi Irene,
> 
> Over the last hour we've been seeing...

From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@acme-fin.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.example
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@acme-fin.com>, support@acme-fin.com
Date: 2026-11-15T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: P1: Spike in 95th latency + errors — need artifacts for audit

Thanks Irene. For the audit we'll need: 

- Delivery as a secure Drive link with a signed manifest.
- A per-request CSV with tokenized session IDs + timestamps and the final model id used.
- KV/cache eviction timeline and per-host memory pressure metrics.

Legal also asked for a short statement on data handling during the incident: were any artifacts copied off-platform, who had access, and what ACLs were applied. If you can include the internal ticket/incident ID and confirm whether a legal hold can be placed on the artifacts, that would be great.

We cannot accept unredacted prompts without an NDA/consent; tokenized data is OK. Our audit lead is cc'd.

—Lydia

-----Original message-----

From: monica.patel@redwood.example
To: jonas.weber@redwood.example, david.kim@redwood.example, rishi.malhotra@redwood.example
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.example
Date: 2026-11-15T09:55:00-08:00
Subject: ACME forensic pack: immediate actions (internal)

Team — ACME requested a secure artifact package for an audit. Action items: 

- Jonas: snapshot KV cache state from nodes t3-inf-12..t3-inf-18 for window 2026-11-15T08:05–08:58Z. Include eviction logs and memory stats.
- David: export per-request metadata for /generate route in that window. Tokenize session IDs (sha256(session_id)). Do NOT include raw prompts without a signed request from ACME legal.
- Rishi: prepare server error logs and compile stack traces; sanitize IPs and remove any ephemeral credentials. Include a redaction report describing what's been removed.

Make a forensics archive, compute SHA256 and MD5 manifests, and record who downloads the archive in our internal custody log. Put the archive in the secure incident bucket (s3://redwood-incidents/acme/2026-11-15/) and set object ACL to restricted. We'll share a secure Drive link to ACME with view + download restricted to their security group.

Reference: forensics-playbook.pdf (attached) — follow the chain-of-custody section.

Monica
Director, Customer Reliability

Attachments: forensics-playbook.pdf (stub)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.example>
To: monica.patel@redwood.example, jonas.weber@redwood.example, rishi.malhotra@redwood.example
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.example
Date: 2026-11-15T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ACME forensic pack: immediate actions (internal)

Folks — export complete. Contents of archive: 

- acme-incident-logs-20261115.zip (per-request CSV, server_error_logs/*.log, cache_evictions/*.log)
- acme-logs-manifest-20261115.txt (SHA256/MD5 checksums for every file)
- redaction-report-20261115.txt (summary of fields redacted: IPs, full prompts removed where flagged)

Notes: 
- Per-request CSV includes: timestamp (UTC), endpoint, model_id, token_count, sha256(session_id). We did not include prompt text.
- Cache snapshots include per-node mem pressure and eviction timestamps.
- All artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/acme/2026-11-15/ and ACL set to incident-only.
- Manifest hashes:
  SHA256(acme-incident-logs-20261115.zip) = 3f6b9a8e9b7c2d4f1a5e2c8f9d0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8

Next: Irene, I'll put the secure Drive link in a ticket and attach the manifest for ACME. We'll add an entry to our custody ledger and capture the reviewer (system: infra-exports@redwood.example).

David
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme-incident-logs-20261115.zip (stub), acme-logs-manifest-20261115.txt (stub), redaction-report-20261115.txt (stub)

From: irene.choi@redwood.example
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@acme-fin.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@acme-fin.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.example, david.kim@redwood.example, jonas.weber@redwood.example
Date: 2026-11-15T12:10:00-08:00
Subject: ACME forensic artifact delivery & chain-of-custody summary

Lydia / Marco — summary and delivery notes: 

1) Delivery: secure Drive link (internal doc) posted to ticket and shared with your security group. Link: https://drive.redwood.example/secure/acme/incident-20261115 (access restricted).
2) Archive: acme-incident-logs-20261115.zip — contains per-request metadata (tokenized session ids), server_error_logs, cache_evictions, and a redaction report. No unredacted prompts were included.
3) Manifest: acme-logs-manifest-20261115.txt (SHA256 + MD5) included and published alongside the archive. SHA256 checksum: 3f6b9a8e9b7c2d4f1a5e2c8f9d0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8.
4) Chain-of-custody: created incident export ticket IR-20261115-ACME; artifact uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/acme/2026-11-15/ with ACL incident-only. Export performed by david.kim@redwood.example; manifest signed by irene.choi@redwood.example. Access log will show any download events and will be exported to ACME if requested.
5) Retention: artifacts will be retained in the incident bucket for 90 days by default unless ACME requests an extended retention or a formal legal hold. After 90 days they will be archived to secure long-term storage (encrypted) and available on request.

If ACME legal needs a notarized or signed statement, we can produce a formal chain-of-custody letter and MD5/SHA checksums on company letterhead; let us know. If you require raw prompt text for specific session IDs, please have your legal team send an explicit signed request outlining the justification.

Irene
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme-incident-logs-20261115.zip (stub), acme-logs-manifest-20261115.txt (stub)
